"When this defends, effects don't trigger when an attack hits this chain link UNLESS the attacking hero pays {r}." CR sec.926 describes this card in exactly those terms: the hit effect produces no triggered layer. It had been a PAY_OR_DAMAGE dealing 1 damage, which is neither the payment structure nor the effect, and it sat in KNOWN_UNIMPLEMENTED waiting for trigger suppression to exist. Suppression is chain-link scoped here (a flag on the combat) where Dense Blue Mist's is turn scoped (a marker on the player), which is why SUPPRESS_HIT_TRIGGERS takes a scope.

Still not modelled, and said so rather than left looking finished: "this can only be played from arsenal" is a play-legality restriction with no hook. The card is reachable from hand, which makes it more permissive than printed.
